market_question: Will the Oklahoma City Thunder win the NBA Western Conference Finals?
reasoning: The Thunder are a top Western Conference team, but an implied 68.5% chance to win the 2026 West Finals is far too high given the league's parity and the long time horizon. Even elite teams typically carry 30–40% estimates this far out due to injury risk and other strong contenders like Denver, Dallas, and Minnesota.
evidence_points: The 2025-26 season is over a year away, introducing massive uncertainty about roster moves and health.
Multiple West teams (Nuggets, Mavericks, Timberwolves, Suns) are capable of eliminating the Thunder in any playoff round.
Historical betting markets rarely assign >50% conference win probability to any team before a season begins.
sources_consulted: general NBA team strength and parity analysis
